Strip is longer than the hut photographed; shopfront-style windows repeated along the front. Deep oxblood horizontal siding, two tall white windows flanking one panelled door, hipped shingle roof with deep eave. Applied: painted-clapboard, deeper saturated wall (a85f54, lum 0.17), window pair flanking the door, other windows thinned. No key for a hipped roof or eave overhang; hand.py re-aligned to the current window/door layout, corner boards and a deep dark shingle eave band added; wall saturated to d04a3e (lum 0.19) so it reads oxblood not pink.
